label: Sinusoidal-forcing scenes · four grid shapes · 8 and 16 cells per metre
description: Sealed boxes of water pushed by one forcing blob whose centre and strength vary sinusoidally. Grids 16x16x16, 9x11x11, 15x6x8 and 32x32x32. These are the scenes the earlier models were fitted and confirmed on; every scene labelled reserved here has already been used to check an earlier model. Every scene has its own seed, so each is its own group; origin names the earlier bank it was first simulated for.
